gbm_population_evidence.quote: Single macroscopic tumor focus with the appearance of glioblastoma multiforme on MRI with contrast

candidate_evidence.quote: MRI+T1C in fusion with FET-PET will be used for tumor resection and/or radiotherapy planning.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Primary tumor, without neurosurgical, radiotherapy or oncology intervention. Prior tumor biopsy is allowed.

role_evidence.quote: MRI+T1C in fusion with FET-PET will be used for tumor resection and/or radiotherapy planning.

agents.drug_class_hint: amino acid PET tracer 18F-FET (18F) used for surgical and radiotherapy planning
arms: Resection and radiotherapy according to the MRI & PET fusion
Radiotherapy according to the MRI & PET fusion

coder_notes: Imaging-guided surgery/radiotherapy planning trial (phase NA); the only drug is the 18F-FET PET tracer embedded in the 'MRI & PET fusion' intervention, coded diagnostic_agent. Stupp temozolomide is mentioned only as background standard of care in the summary, not as a protocol treatment, so not listed. Gadolinium MRI contrast is used in all arms for routine imaging and not listed as a registered drug intervention. Keywords mention methionine but the record describes 18F-FET.
